summary: Visible change: a message rendered in the browser before react-markdown has loaded shows skeleton lines instead of its raw Markdown source (not the running turn). AiChatProvider now loads react-markdown when it mounts; new preloadMarkdown() and markdown.preload. Server HTML is unchanged.
howTo: Nothing to do. While loading, [data-component="markdown"] contains div[data-element="markdown-skeleton"][data-state="loading"][aria-busy="true"] with up to 8 span[data-element="markdown-skeleton-line"] and a width estimated from the source, plus a visually hidden text for screen readers (locale key markdownLoadingLabel, optional, German ships; not announced). Its size is inline, so it takes space in content-sized bubbles, with unstyled and in own layouts; adjust it with --cm-markdown-skeleton-color, -line-height, -gap, -radius, -padding and -max-width. The panel stylesheet adds a pulse, off under prefers-reduced-motion. The answer streaming in and the question it answers keep the raw text while loading, as before. react-markdown is now downloaded when AiChatProvider mounts, also while a floating chat is closed and for headless use of the provider, unless components.Markdown or components.MessageBubble is set; markdown={{ preload: false }} restores loading at the first message. Without react-markdown installed, its console.warn now appears at mount. preloadMarkdown() starts earlier (same promise every call, never rejects, safe on the server; once resolved, Markdown renders without a skeleton). Server HTML (renderToString, streaming) is unchanged. Hydration reports the same errors as before, but when React replaces a server-rendered message while react-markdown is still loading, the skeleton shows where the raw source showed before. Tests that read [data-component="markdown"] text right after render now see the skeleton: wait for the rendered Markdown (findBy…/waitFor, or await preloadMarkdown() before rendering). For mention chips in a chat restored with session.load or createLocalSessionStore, set entityDeclarations; the streamed declarations are not stored.
